meta.title: PartiDesign: what the model was trained on
meta.subtitle: Eleven sources, reweighted per modality, cropped to 512 tokens

cards.title: The eleven sources, and their weights in the universal mixture
items: Predicted structure: AFDB-v4 monomers at 20% (588,571 Genie 2 representatives, pLDDT at least 80), Teddymer synthetic interfaces at 20% (519,558 structures), NuFold-DB predicted RNA at 5%

Experimental assemblies from the Protenix-v2 PDB index, released before 2025-07-01 at 4.5 A or better: protein-protein 6%, nucleic monomers 5%, protein-nucleic 15%, nucleic-nucleic 4%, nucleic-ligand 4%, cyclic peptides 4%
Docked and curated ligand complexes: PLINDER 2024-04/v1 at 15%, CrossDocked2020 v1.3 positive poses at 12%
Weights apply to sampling requests, not to accepted examples: a source whose example fails preparation is replaced, which shifts the realized distribution

cards.title: What one training example looks like
items: At most 512 tokens. A polymer residue is one token; each ligand heavy atom is its own token. Ligands are never cut in half
Interface crops are kept only if both chosen endpoints survive and at least one resolved heavy-atom contact falls within 0.5 nm. Design segments span 50 to 256 tokens with 10 tokens of anchor padding

Conditions are drawn at random so the one model learns every control: motifs at 0.25 full-token and 0.15 selected-atom for proteins, visible identity 20% of the time, fine secondary structure 16%, hotspots within 0.8 nm
No MSA and no template features anywhere in training

cards.title: How the held-out data was separated, and how it was not
items: RecentPDB and PoseBusters supply the validation examples, and training excludes PDB entries that appear in them

That exclusion acts at the PDB-entry level only. The paper states it does not implement homology-based or ligand-scaffold-based partitioning, and that CrossDocked2020 and the PDB subsets can contain related structures
So a design target can resemble a training structure without sharing its PDB ID, and the benchmark numbers should be read with that in mind
